chapter_notes.objective_distribution: Unlike Dermatology (dominated by a single objective 38), Endocrinology's MCC evidence is spread across 18 distinct presentation-based objectives because MCC's framework for this chapter is granular symptom/sign-based (Hyperglycemia=130, Hypoglycemia=129, Calcium disorders=12-2, Neck masses and thyroid disease=63, Hypertension=9-1, etc.) rather than one umbrella objective. Most named Toronto Notes diagnoses in this chapter still map as COMPONENT of a broader presentation objective (e.g. individual thyrotoxicosis etiologies as COMPONENT of objective 63) rather than each independently DIRECT, per CLAUDE.md's guidance against forcing DIRECT status merely because a diagnosis is named. A unit earned DIRECT chiefly where the objective's own causal_conditions/key_objectives text names the exact presentation or mechanism (e.g. objective 110-2's causal_conditions explicitly list 'diabetes insipidus: central versus nephrogenic' for SU-E-21; objective 10-1's key objective names 'gynecomastia' verbatim for SU-E-55).
chapter_notes.no_weak_mappings: Zero WEAK mapping_strength citations in this chapter - every mcc_evidence entry achieved at least MODERATE strength, so no unit required requires_scope_review flagging on mapping-quality grounds.
chapter_notes.mcc_registry_search_note: The scope packet's bounded candidate_mcc_objectives set (27 entries, mostly generic Study-Smarter cross-discipline matches such as substance use disorders, SIDS, and OCD) did not contain dedicated objectives for the chapter's highest-yield content (diabetes, thyroid disease specifics, pituitary, adrenal, osteoporosis). Per docs/scope-chapter-workflow.md's instruction to use search-mcc-objectives when the candidate set is insufficient, targeted searches of the full canonical registory were run for terms including diabetes, thyroid, hyperglycemia, hypoglycemia, pituitary, adrenal, Cushing, hypogonadism, gynecomastia, osteoporosis, hypertension, hyponatremia, hypokalemia, polyuria, and amenorrhea, surfacing 12 additional relevant objectives (130, 101, 57, 10-1, 79-2, 99-2, 9-1, 33, 118-1, 110-2, 56-1, 118-2) not present in the bounded candidate set. Several searched terms (thyroid hyper-/hypothyroidism specifically, adrenal, Cushing, pituitary, hypogonadism, gynecomastia, osteoporosis, goiter, menstrual, erectile, electrolyte, endocrine) returned zero matches, confirming MCC genuinely has no dedicated named objective for these and they are legitimately mapped as COMPONENT/MODERATE evidence under the nearest presentation-based objective rather than left unmapped or forced to a non-existent DIRECT id.
chapter_notes.toc_structural_quality: Chapter E's TOC page (pdf 309) is single-column and produced no two-column-merge garbling, in contrast to Dermatology. research/tn2025/unresolved_headings.json has zero entries for chapter E. The one genuine structural artifact - E.S03.T02/E.S03.T03, a single 'Pre-Diabetes (Impaired Glucose Tolerance/Impaired Fasting Glucose)' heading split across two TOC nodes by line-wrap parsing - was resolved via body-heading confirmation (pdf 315) and merged into one study unit (SU-E-08).
